attributes.powers:
For your combat check, reveal this card to use your Strength or Disable skill + 1d4; you may additionally discard this card to add another 1d4 and the Knife and Piercing traits.

On your Diplomacy or Disable check, discard this card to add 1d4. 

On your combat check, if you played another weapon, discard this card to add 1d4.
